texts.text:
I turn. The grass parts under my feet.

The assembly makes room. No one reaches for me.

Seren stays kneeling, her face the only steady thing.

The presiding Dohkar's voice carries over the parting bodies.

THE PRESIDING DOHKAR: "Her flight is recorded."

The words land like a seal pressed into wax.

THE PRESIDING DOHKAR: "It will stand as evidence before the inquiry."

My standing narrows with every syllable.

I feel the weight of the Dohkar's gaze as a new pressure.

Julian steps forward without hurry.

JULIAN: "I hear where she is aligned."

The room rearranges around his stillness.

JULIAN: "Everything in her points one way."

He does not move closer. The space between us holds the question.

The Dohkar's script flares flat with irritation.

My fingers tighten around the deck.

The choice sits between claiming the interference and letting the assumption stand.

Julian's presence is the only thing that has not yet narrowed.

The Dohkar's words have already set the record.

I realize that old tarot deck is still in my hand. Reassuringly solid. Present. One of the heavy gold cards slips out — “Petition Fate” is inscribed in it.

I stand at the threshold where the clearing ends and the path begins.

The grass is cold under my feet.

Julian waits just beyond the last candle.

The Dohkar's words still press on my standing.

I hold the deck in both hands.

LIRAEL: "I wish for the memory to stay mine a little longer."

A single candle flickers though no wind moves.

The flame steadies again.

The Answer warms in my palm.

Julian has not moved.

The weight in my chest grows heavier.

LIRAEL: "The thing you almost said folds back into your chest."

The Answer lifts from my palm on its own.

It hovers between us.

A thread of silver light uncoils from the blade.

It reaches for my hands.

Julian watches without moving.

The light brushes my fingers.

The memory rises like breath from water.

It coils around the blade.

The Answer draws the memory of the lost one from my hands.

Julian's stillness rearranges the space between us.

The memory hovers between the blade and my open palm.

I feel the choice already forming.

Surrender the memory or demand its return.

I realize the deck is still in my hand. As I slide Petition Fate back in, I notice a flash of red in the otherwise gold stack. “Tempt Fate.” Great-grandma never let me play with that one. A sword raised to a blood-red sky, lightning arcing down from the clouds (or maybe arcing up?) Ow! Static shock reminds me I need to pay attention to the present…

The presiding Dohkar's voice carries across the chamber.

My fingers tighten around the Answer.

LIRAEL: "*mm*"

The blade warms against my palm.

The presiding Dohkar names the inquiry.

My conduct at the rite is under review.

Julian is named as the one who demanded it.

The restrictions are read aloud.

I must remain under supervision.

Julian stands resolute.

The chamber grows still.

My grip does not loosen.

The Dohkar finishes the notice.

Julian's stillness shifts the air.

He steps once closer.

The restrictions bind my movements.

I cannot leave the grounds.

Julian watches without speaking.

The weight of his silence presses.

I cannot explain the wish.

The chamber waits.

Julian's hand moves toward the blade.

The choice forms in the silence.

Accept the bounds or contest them.

The Answer cools in my hand.

oas.pcSay: I shaped nothing. Ask me properly.
oas.pcSayRaw: I shaped nothing. Ask me properly.
oas.liDialogue: You shaped it with every glance you cast my way during the rite, every tilt of your head that pulled eyes from the circle to you. Did you call to me hoping the Provast would rescue you from the Dohkar's charge?
oas.liAction: Julian steps closer, his gaze fixed on mine.

oas.pcSay: Let them witness how the question cuts.
oas.pcDo: I tilt my palm, letting the hooked blade graze his skin.
oas.pcSayRaw: Let them see how much this question stings.
oas.pcDoRaw: Tilt my palm, letting the blade graze his skin
oas.liDialogue: The blade answers before your tongue can lie.
oas.liAction: His fingers close around my wrist, halting the cut before it deepens.

oas.pcSay: I am no longer a piece upon your board.
oas.pcDo: I turn the blade toward him, claiming my ground.
oas.pcSayRaw: I'm not just a pawn in your game anymore.
oas.pcDoRaw: Turn the blade to face him, assert my stance
oas.liDialogue: The Answer knows its own master. Will you draw the Provast's blood before the Dohkar's eyes?
oas.liAction: His fingers close around my wrist, halting the blade before it finds him.

oas.pcSay: Let them see how much this question stings.
oas.pcDo: I tilt my palm, the hooked edge halting a breath from his skin.
oas.pcSayRaw: Let them see how much this question stings.
oas.pcDoRaw: Tilt my palm, letting the blade graze his skin
oas.liDialogue: The Answer is well aware of the contours of your desire.
oas.liAction: Julian's hand twists, the tip of the blade grazing the fabric of my sleeve instead.

oas.pcSay: I will not speak until the true cost is laid bare.
oas.pcDo: I step back, the double-ended shaft steady in my grasp.
oas.pcSayRaw: I won't answer until I know what’s really at stake.
oas.pcDoRaw: Step back, holding the blade firmly in my grip
oas.liDialogue: Your quiet only fuels the ritual's craving. What secret do you protect so tenaciously that it overshadows the crowd's scrutiny?
oas.liAction: Julian stands resolute, the electric tension surrounding us heavy with ancient vows.

oas.liDialogue: The shaft already savors your stillness. Reveal the price you dread, or allow the gathering to savor it instead.
